title: SIGSEGV(segmentation fault) with fzf inside terminal emulator

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
### Neovim version (nvim -v)

NVIM v0.7.0-dev+737-g818ae74ea

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

idk

### Operating system/version

5.10.70-1-MANJARO

### Terminal name/version

xfce4-terminal

### $TERM environment variable

xterm-256color

### Installation

AUR

### How to reproduce the issue

#### Script
The following script is used to create a simple popup window. Save the script to somewhere in your local file system.

```lua
local api = vim.api

local function create_temp_buf()
  local buf = api.nvim_create_buf(false, true) -- create new emtpy buffer
  return buf
end

local function create_popup_win(buf)
  -- get dimensions
  local width = api.nvim_get_option("columns")
  local height = api.nvim_get_option("lines")

  -- calculate our floating window size
  local win_height = math.ceil(height * 0.5 - 4)
  local win_width = math.ceil(width * 0.5)

  -- and its starting position
  local row = math.ceil((height - win_height) / 2 - 1)
  local col = math.ceil((width - win_width) / 2)

  -- set some options
  local opts = {
    style = "minimal",
    relative = "editor",
    width = win_width,
    height = win_height,
    row = row,
    col = col,
    border = 'single',
  }

  -- and finally create it with buffer attached
  win = api.nvim_open_win(buf, true, opts)
end

local buf, win

local function open_window()
  buf = create_temp_buf()
  win = create_popup_win(buf)
end

open_window()
```

#### Reproduciable Steps
- Start pure nvim: `/usr/bin/nvim --clean`
- Open a floating window by sourcing the simple popup window script.
- Run a terminal with fzf command inside the floating window by executing `:terminal fzf --reverse --height 80\%`

  (to keep fzf program busy, you can `:lcd` to a directory with a large number of files)

- During fzf continuing searching files, exit the floating window by fisrt pressing `<C-\><C-n>` then executing `:q`

### Expected behavior

The popup window exits without any error.

### Actual behavior

The nvim program crashes with message `fish: Job 1, '/usr/bin/nvim --clean' terminated by signal SIGSEGV (Address boundary error)`
  ![https://i.imgur.com/lysH6wS.gif](https://i.imgur.com/lysH6wS.gif)

### Additional Info
Tried removing one of the `--reverse` and `--height 80%` options for fzf and after that no segmentation fault happened.
